content.name: Book
entries: A book might contain poetry, historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of lore, diagrams and notes on gnomish contraptions, or just about anything else that can be represented using text or pictures. A book of spells is a {@item spellbook|srd51}.

content.name: Book
entries: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|SRD52}, {@skill History|SRD52}, {@skill Nature|SRD52}, or {@skill Religion|SRD52}) checks you make about that topic.
